segments.say: White to move. Checkmate in one. And you only get a knight.
segments.caption: White to move: mate in 1

segments.say: Black has a rook, two pawns and a king. Looks impossible, right? Pause now and find it.
segments.caption: PAUSE & FIND IT

segments.say: The king is trapped by its own pieces. This is called a smothered mate, and it is the coolest checkmate in chess.
segments.caption: Trapped by its own army

segments.say: Did you find it? Comment how many seconds it took you.
segments.caption: How fast did YOU find it?
